decision: Keep heap decoding separate from host store I/O
why: MO-151 assigns these owners; the VM invokes handlers only with typed values
evidence: docs/design/services.md

decision: Use rollback-journal SQLite with EXTRA synchronization and an in-memory fake
why: Both stores use the same transaction and record implementation
evidence: docs/design/saved-state.md
result: Process-crash tests pass; no power-loss claim

decision: Fix allocator initialization, charge before allocation, disable triggers and refuse special paths
why: Independent review identified startup crash and false durability promises
evidence: tests/test_service_store.c

decision: Extend layout lookup to records and tuples
why: Scalar-only recovery tests missed valid compound values that could not decode
evidence: tests/test_saved_state.c
result: Roundtrip test failed before fix and passes after

decision: Rerun failed full build and fuzz invocations after removing fallthrough
why: GCC passed but Clang refused unannotated fallthrough; partial passes are not a green gate
evidence: /tmp/mo158-full-builds-1.log

decision: Recover predecessor tree via thread file transfer, verify instead of re-deriving
why: Prior owner blocked; its work existed only as uncommitted edits
evidence: download_thread_changes; targeted tests pass on recovered tree
result: Recovered; SQLite archive SHA3 and files match upstream

decision: Drop store reread on supervisor restart
why: In-memory state equals the last commit; rereading held two copies of state at once
evidence: docs/design/services.md section 9

decision: Size every record payload by MO_LIMIT_SAVED_BYTES and frames by payload plus 34
why: Live copies allowed 16 MiB values the frame check refused, bricking stores at the next due snapshot
evidence: payload_limit and message_limit tests; mutants red

decision: Refuse oversized state-changing messages at send with MO_SERVICE_MEMORY
why: Combined arguments could exceed the log payload and stop the service with MO_SERVICE_STORE
evidence: message_limit test

decision: Charge SQLite blocks exactly with malloc in base
why: Per-block arenas charged 4 KiB minimum, about 2.5-4x real use
evidence: allocator_bound test

decision: Report replay MEMORY/WORK as such and take a due snapshot only when missing
why: Resource limits are not corrupt data; rewriting a current snapshot cost a synced transaction per open
evidence: failed_snapshot test; mutant red

decision: Leave a zero-byte file from a crashed first open refused and documented
why: No message was acknowledged from it; automatic reset would also hide real truncation
evidence: docs/design/saved-state.md

decision: Copy durable values through the saved codec before accepting them
why: Encoding expands sharing, so an acknowledged update could be too large to decode on recovery
evidence: shared_recovery_bound and shared_result_bound; step-path mutant red

decision: Move head and snapshot into separate one-row tables
why: UPDATE of head rewrote the whole snapshot row on every append: 35.7 MB peak and a full snapshot write per message
evidence: sqlite3_memory_highwater: disk append peak 35.7 MB to 17.1 MB, idle 2.17 MB to 0.33 MB

decision: Cap open stores at 8, page cache at 256 KiB, and size the shared budget at 24 MiB per store
why: All stores share SQLite's global allocator; review reproduced a 28th warmed store failing a 4 MB snapshot
evidence: payload_limit runs 16 MiB operations with 8 stores open and refuses a 9th

decision: Add exact-boundary tests for state and message payloads, replay WORK, checksum, current-snapshot reopen and reply value
why: Review mutants M1 M2 M3 M5 M9 stayed green
evidence: All five now red; M4 is equivalent because mo_value_encode caps at the limit itself; M10 is equivalent because replacement refuses read-only results

decision: Zero the reply value when a commit or copy fails after the handler returned
why: An embedding could forward a reply for state that was never committed
evidence: reply hook asserts non-OK replies carry no value

decision: Map saved type tags with a switch
why: Designated initializers still defaulted a new kind to tag 0
evidence: '-Wswitch-enum covers new kinds

decision: Classify LOAD failures: SQLite corruption codes and content checks are invalid data, every other SQLite failure is a store failure
why: An I/O error or exhausted store budget was reported as invalid saved state, inviting deletion of a good database
evidence: read failure test: injected IOERR on snapshot read gives MO_SERVICE_STORE, then a clean reopen succeeds; mutant red

decision: Pin user_version cases, the schema split's memory, the page cache, slot release, replay MEMORY and every saved tag
why: Review mutants M1 M2 M4 M6 M7 M14 M17 stayed green
evidence: All now red; M3 (accept version 2) is equivalent because the snapshot branch refuses any version but 1

decision: Treat SQLITE_TOOBIG during LOAD as invalid data and test every LOAD step's failure class
why: A row larger than the runtime can write was reported as a retryable store failure; step failures on head, version and log were untested
evidence: read_failures (IOERR, BUSY, NOMEM, CORRUPT on each query), oversized-row corruption edits, long_tail; five mutants red
result: Fixed; NOTADB, the 0xff mask and finalize-only failures remain untested

decision: Adopt Robert's STORE and SAVED_INVALID wording and zero-byte deletion guidance
why: Robert approved #242 with exact text changes before merge
evidence: foreign_image test: another image's store is refused and the file bytes are unchanged
